title: Crash on Upgrade of project

### System information

linux - Godot Engine v4.8.dev5.custom_build.3000096f9 - AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT

### Issue description

When upgrading a project from 4.4,  and selecting "Upgrade all project files", a crash occurs

Not checking the above option, the project opens fine.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)


Adding a pointer check in ScriptEditor::_connect_to_scene_recursive, stops the crash.   Though I'm not sure, if it's fixing the issue or just hiding the real cause.
